title: Synthetic demo: the engraving of what changed
attribution: Synthetic data generated by seismic_art (no real survey)
amp_note: amplitude ~ int8 / 127 * amp_clip (the base's 99th percentile); relative, compare within this file only

difference_rms_ratio.note: RMS of the difference over RMS of the base, in the quiet window (the grain) and below it

notes: amplitudes are relative; compare within this file only

the monitor is read at the base's traces, moved by +4 ms and scaled by 1.00, both measured over 140-270 where nothing in the earth should have changed (median lag of 150 trace pairs; a constant offset between two processings is not a change in the earth)
the grain: after those corrections the two vintages still differ by an NRMS of 0.23 (correlation 0.98) in that window; a difference deeper down must be read against it

the engraving draws monitor minus base after the alignment: what both vintages share is erased, what the monitor adds or lacks remains; the same noise is in every part of it, so marks count only where they stand out from the grain above
inline 155, through the centre of the changed patch

synthetic truth: the monitor differs from the base inside one round patch of 450 m radius (thin-bed reflections weakened by 40%, every boundary below the top 3 ms earlier), has new noise everywhere, and was written one sample (4 ms) late
